pr.title: Rename the loop band's command to /projector
pr.head: b90b2975a003286514849d3138622c7eb8e3fa0e

summary: Projector's Claude Code plugin ships a hooks module, hooks/register.tsx, that draws a band above the prompt: one line for each open pull request that your review and fix loops track. Until now you showed or hid it with the slash command /loop-prs, and the module kept its session state under keys named for loops.

The band is about to hold more than loops. Pull request #268 plans to show an agent's questions there too, so this change renames the command to /projector, after the plugin that owns the band. The name is unlikely to clash with another plugin's command, and /status, the obvious general name, already belongs to Claude Code.

The four session state keys lose their loop prefix in the same way. seenLoops keeps its name, because it really does record loops. A session that already had the band open starts the renamed keys empty after it reloads the plugin, so the band stays hidden there until you run /projector or the session starts a loop's watcher.

groups.title: The command and its state keys
groups.kicker: The hooks module registers /projector and stores the band's state under band-named keys
intro: A Claude Code hooks module declares a slash command with $.command.register and answers it with a command.run hook that names the same command. Both now say projector, and the command's description, its replies, and the toast it shows for an unreadable watcher say Projector's band instead of loop PRs.

The module keeps the band's state in Claude Code's per-session plugin state, read and written through atom handles keyed by name. hooks/types.d.ts declares the shape of each key for the type checker, so the declaration and the four atom keys must agree.

checks.text: git grep at the head finds no loop-prs, loopSnapshot, loopNow, isLoopBandShown, loopDrawer, or loop PRs anywhere in the repository, skills and plans included.

files.note: Declares the renamed keys in the plugin's session state.

checks.text: These keys match the four atom keys in hooks/register.tsx. claude plugin validate . reports state reads and writes of only the band* keys and seenLoops.

files.note: Registers and answers /projector, and reads the band's state under the renamed keys.

checks.text: A session that had the band open before it reloads the plugin finds the new keys empty, so isBandShown reads false and the band stays hidden until you run /projector or a watcher starts. The old keys stay in the session's state, unread.
The registered name and the command.run matcher below agree: claude plugin validate . lists command.run{command=projector} and reports that the module answers its own command.

groups.title: Test and documentation
groups.kicker: The band's test and the plugin guide use the new names
intro: The band's test runs the command and seeds an earlier version's snapshot under the state key the module reads, so both had to follow the rename. docs/plugins.md tells you how to show and hide the band and how to name a tracked file by hand.
